description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pennithawa, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurubegala District - Cad. Map No. 420949
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
